exposure_anchors.1: Negligible: no payment flows, fully manual, owner-only operation, no online presence.
exposure_anchors.2: Limited: small invoice volumes, no card acceptance, no online customer onboarding.
exposure_anchors.3: Moderate: regular invoicing, occasional bank-detail changes, some online customer interactions.
exposure_anchors.4: High: significant payment volumes, online customer onboarding, card acceptance, supplier flows in multiple currencies.
exposure_anchors.5: Severe: high-volume payments, instant rails, large supplier book, online lending / consumer credit, mass-market customer base.

threat_credibility_anchors.1: Sector / region with no documented fraud activity targeting this profile.
threat_credibility_anchors.2: Documented but rare incidents in this sector / region.
threat_credibility_anchors.3: Active fraud campaigns documented in the sector or region; incidents within peer firms.
threat_credibility_anchors.4: Active and adapted: fraud actors actively probe controls; sector is known target.
threat_credibility_anchors.5: Active and targeted: entity has incidents on file; published industry alerts name the sector.

vulnerability_anchors.1: All controls in place + tested + audited; staff trained; case management mature.
vulnerability_anchors.2: Controls in place with minor gaps; recent review.
vulnerability_anchors.3: Controls partial: callback exists but inconsistent; behavioural rules limited; mule detection thin.
vulnerability_anchors.4: Multiple controls absent or untested; segregation weak; onboarding fraud signals minimal.
vulnerability_anchors.5: No callback / dual control / behavioural monitoring; no onboarding fraud checks.
